about_the_game:
Ready to lead your pharma company or biotech startup to success?
The Pharma R&D Pipeline Manager Game is a round-based educational business and management simulation.

Step into the shoes of a Pharma R&D CEO! Players will immerse themselves in the dynamic management world of pharmaceutical research & development, navigating the challenging journey from initial discovery through clinical development to final regulatory approval.

  • Lead & Motivate: the player leads the most important research & development departments and assembles a strong and motivating management team

  • Do business deals: The player needs to close transformative business deals to strategically enhance the companies project portfolio/pipeline

  • Make pipeline decisions: the player needs to optimize the project pipeline by making strategic project and pipeline decisions

  • Ensure financing: ensure the financing of your company

Gain valuable insights into the success probabilities of R&D phases, navigate business development strategies, and overcome financial challenges. You’ll also learn how leadership skills and a strong organizational culture are vital for fostering employee engagement, boosting organizational effectiveness, and achieving overall success.

In every dashboard you can use the interactive help system to get additional information on drug development, finance and key technical terms.

Have fun, play and learn!
